name: feedsift
description: Find the signal. Skip the noise. FeedSift helps you hide distractions and focus your LinkedIn feed.

scripts.build: npm run sync && rm -rf dist feedsift-extension && mkdir -p dist && cp -R src feedsift-extension && zip -r dist/feedsift-v$npm_package_version.zip feedsift-extension -x "*/.*" "*/__MACOSX/*" && rm -rf feedsift-extension
scripts.release-gh: npm run release && gh release create v$npm_package_version --generate-notes
scripts.version: npm run sync && git add src/manifest.json
scripts.deploy: npm version patch && git push origin main --follow-tags

author: Stéphane Hamel (Immeria Inc.)
